status.en: 28 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Damascus, Quneitra and Golan Heights.
status.nb: 28 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Golanhøydene.

summary.en: Turkish forces remain in Syria and Iraq until border security is assured, while Damascus officials warn Druze factions, allegedly backed by Israel, may launch attacks in Sweida. DNA-based identification of the missing offers families hope, and a security vacuum has seen 38 civilians killed in 33 homicides since early October. The Syrian court continues trials of three defendants in transitional justice cases, and regional partners discussed recovery and food security at Doha and FAO meetings. The UCDP recorded 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Tyrkiske styrker blir i Syria og Irak til grense­ sikkerheten er sikret, mens damaskiske tjenestemenn advarer at drusj-fraksjoner, angivelig støttet av Israel, kan starte angrep i Sweida. DNA-basert identifisering av de savnede gir familiene håp, og et sikkerhetsvakuum har ført til at 38 sivile er drept i 33 drap siden tidlig i oktober. Den syriske domstolen fortsetter rettssakene mot tre tiltalte i overgangsrettslige saker, og regionale partnere diskuterte gjenoppretting og matsikkerhet på Doha‑ og FAO-møtene. UCDP registrerte 2 732 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
